caption: The drawing features a single wooden table with an octagonal-shaped top, depicted in shades of brown. The tabletop is a darker brown color, while the sides and the drawer panel are a lighter, natural wood tone with visible wood grain texture. The front of the table has a single drawer with two round brass-colored knobs and a small keyhole at the center. The table stands on four tall, slender legs that are darker in tone than the side panels, and each leg features subtle vertical grooves and decorative elements near the top and bottom. The table is shown against a plain, light beige background with a rectangular frame sketched around it, and there are no additional objects or decorations in the drawing.
